sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.

Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA for the State; Shri Arshad Hafeez Khan,
learned counsel for the informant and perused the record.

2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.88 of 2024, under Section 363, 366, 376 IPC &
Section 5(J)(ii)/6 of POCSO Act, P.S. Satrikh, District Barabanki.
3.
In terms of the FIR, a missing person report was lodged alleging that daughter of the informant aged about 17 years was enticed away by the applicant.
Subsequently, in the two statements, the victim did not support the prosecution and also stated that both of them have married.
The applicant also admits the factum of marriage.
The victim is pregnant also.

4. Learned AGA has opposed the bail application.

5. Considering the two statements of the victim not supporting the prosecution and the applicant also admitting the factum of marriage, the applicant who is in custody since 26.04.2024 is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
In view thereof, the application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Subhash be released on bail in aforesaid FIR number on his furnishing a personal bond with two sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
7.
It is, however, provided that the applicant shall get the marriage registered within a period of four months of being released from jail.
8. In case the applicant resiles to get the marriage registered, the victim would be at liberty to move a bail cancellation application.

Order Date :- 12.9.2024 nishant  Subhash vs State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. Home Deptt. ... on 12 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/56087897/
